resources.string: NovaRedux has no internet access of its own. This app is the one part of NovaRedux that goes online, and only for web suggestions.

While you type a search in NovaRedux with Web suggestions on, what you have typed goes to the suggestion service of the search engine you chose in NovaRedux. It answers with suggested searches, which NovaRedux shows under its web search row.
Nothing else is sent: no account, no identifiers, no history. This app answers NovaRedux and no other app, and keeps recent answers in memory only, for a few minutes.
To stop it, turn off Web suggestions in NovaRedux’s search settings, or uninstall this app.
